Recommend refining the matrix to distinguish 'new syntax' (api-surface.md required) vs 'new command class within existing syntax' (api-surface.md not required). Non-blocking.

Previously-existing test files in the same directory carry no annotation, creating a growing style inconsistency. Consider establishing a policy for when ★ annotations are cleared (e.g., after each plan's review cycle) to keep the manifest clean over time. Non-blocking.
